name: updated-at-field-omitted-on-insert
$comment: Server-stamped updatedAtField (FM-36) insert-omission: a non-optional updatedAtField field may be OMITTED on insert — the stamp runs before required-field validation, so the omission never reaches the validator (the same authority that overwrites a supplied value). Determinism: the follow-up read filters updatedAt > 0, matching only a server-stamped epoch-ms value; the generated stamp is normalized out of the expected doc.
